title: Interactive patterns & accessibility gap analysis for console components — March 2026
content:
Purpose: Quick working notes capturing accessibility gaps and interactive pattern decisions for console UI components used by the routing/rollouts and optimize flows. This is a working document for grooming the backlog prior to the April sprint. Scope: - Review interactive components used across Console: tables, searchable dropdowns, chips/tokenizers, modals/drawers, live log streaming panel, context menus, and inline editable fields. - Identify accessibility regressions, missing keyboard flows, and ambiguous aria semantics. - Produce concrete fixes, tests, and estimates for backlog grooming. Quick summary of high-impact findings (TL;DR): - Keyboard trap in tokenized input used on the route editing page (current focus not escaping when suggestion list closed) — P0. - Data table row selection uses clickable-only cells (no row-level aria/role mapping) — confusing for screen-reader users; needs role=row/checkbox shift — P1. - Dropdowns with grouped options lose aria-activedescendant when filtered; visible focus outline removed by CSS variable on macOS — P1. - Modal open/close focus management inconsistent between legacy modal and new drawer component — restore focus to trigger and add focus sentinel — P1. - Toasts and ephemeral banners are announced inconsistently; screen reader users miss critical rollout failure messages — P0. Component-by-component notes and wireframe considerations: 1) Tokenizer / Chip input (used in route targeting and API key scopes) - Observed: When user types and arrow-navigates suggestions, Escape closes the list but focus remains in an inert state; backspace behavior inconsistent. - Accessibility issue: Missing aria-expanded toggles and live-region announcements on create/delete. - Wireframe suggestion: Add clear focus ring, a dedicated remove button on each chip with aria-label, and a screen-reader-only summary: "X tags applied" announced when changes happen. - Proposed aria pattern: role="listbox" for suggestion container, options with role="option" and aria-selected toggles. Add aria-live polite region for add/remove events. - Grooming: 3 story points. Owner: Marcus. PR: CON-1123 linked. 2) Searchable grouped dropdowns (model catalog filters) - Observed: Group headings are non-interactive but read as selectable by VoiceOver. Filtering causes active descendant to reset to first item (unexpected). - Fix: Mark group headers with aria-hidden or role="presentation", preserve aria-activedescendant across filter updates unless user typed a new query. - Wireframe tweak: Keep a sticky first selectable item visually. Provide a keyboard hint row at top when open: "Use arrows to navigate, Enter to select, / to focus search". - Grooming: 5 points (some infra work in downshift wrapper). Owner: Aisha. 3) Data table (model list, metrics table) - Observed: Click-only row selection, inconsistent focus target, and missing column headers associations for certain generated columns (like state chips). - Accessibility issue: No aria-describedby mapping for row-level context menus, screen readers land on cell without announcing actionable controls. - Proposed fixes: Implement role="grid" with row/column headers, make selectable rows use proper aria-selected states, add an offscreen instruction for first interactive column. Add a tab-stop on row checkbox only; row click toggles checkbox via click handler, but ensure keyboard toggling via Space/Enter triggers the same. - Wireframe: Provide a pinned checkbox column with visible focus ring and accessible label "Select row for bulk actions". - Grooming: 8 points. Requires SRE/instrumentation to measure if change affects virtualization library. Owner: Tomás. 4) Modal vs Drawer focus & stacking (rollouts modal / support drawer) - Observed: Legacy modal returns focus to body element instead of the triggering button when closed; nested drawer traps focus. - Fix: Use focus sentinel approach, move to a single modal manager utility, and ensure aria-hidden toggles on inert background. - Wireframe: Show a focus-return animation state in prototypes to convey where focus lands. - Grooming: 3 points. Owner: Leah. 5) Toasts, banners, and live regions (notifications for routing failures, rollback events) - Observed: Toasts created by toast library are appended to DOM root with no role or aria-live attributes in some cases; some messages are non-persistent for screen readers. - Fix: Always publish to an aria-live region with role="status" for non-critical and role="alert" for critical failures. Ensure duplicates are announced when content changes. - Test: Screen reader flow that simulates rapid sequence of events (3 failures in 10s). - Grooming: 2 points. Accessibility testing plan (what to run and expected pass/fail): - Keyboard-only walkthroughs: Console main pages, route editor, model catalog, rollout detail. Expected: full tab navigation, no keyboard traps, visible focus outline on all interactive controls. - Screen reader smoke test: NVDA + Firefox (Windows), VoiceOver + Safari (macOS). Expected: clear labeling for tables, forms, and interactive lists; no redundant repeated announcements. - Color contrast sweep: Using current color tokens, collect failing pairs and propose token swaps or use of additional icon/underline cues when contrast cannot be achieved. - Automated checks: axe-core on CI for top-level pages; acknowledge noise from virtualization libraries but surface top 20 unique violations. Backlog grooming notes (priority, estimate, owner): - P0 items: - Tokenizer keyboard trap: 3 points (Marcus) — blocker for feature flagging of audience editor. - Toasts not announced: 2 points (Leah) — blocks rollback alerts for admins. - P1 items: - Focus management for modals/drawers: 3 points (Leah). - Searchable dropdown aria-activedescendant and filter stability: 5 points (Aisha). - Data table grid semantics and keyboard selection: 8 points (Tomás). - P2 items: - Visual focus polish (contrast & outline tokens): 3 points (Design). - Add a11y e2e smoke tests: 5 points (SDET). Design tradeoffs and rationale notes (for PM/dev review): - Virtualized tables: Adding aria roles to each row may increase DOM churning; strategy: provide semantic mapping at the container level and only render accessible subtrees for focused/visible rows. Provide live-region announcements for pagination changes instead of per-row announcements. - Focus rings and design tokens: We need to accept slightly heavier focus rings in macOS to preserve accessibility; consider a token "focus-accent-strong" and run a token audit to decide usage. Open questions (needs design/engineering sync): - Should toasts for critical system errors be modal-like for screen reader users (role=alertdialog) rather than role=alert? (Tradeoff: interruption vs discoverability.) - Dropdown wrapper: move off-the-shelf library (Downshift) to internal abstraction? How much rebuild cost vs accessibility benefits? - Virtualization + screen reader: can we prove which rows are actually needed to render for SR users vs full render? (SRE measurement request). Next steps and meeting plan: - 2026-03-22 10:00AM PT: cross-functional sync with design, eng (frontend), and SDET. Agenda: confirm P0 fixes, assign stories, and agree on testing matrix. - Create Jira tickets for each line item above with the estimates and link in this doc. - Prototype tokenizer fixes in feature branch and run NVDA smoke test. Notes-to-self / loose TODOs (working): - Add example code snippets for aria attributes for tokenizer and table (copy from WAI-ARIA authoring practices). - Draft a short user-facing note for admin docs about how to use keyboard navigation in rollout editor. - Pair with SDET to add a11y smoke job in CI for console master branch. References and helpful resources: - WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices: https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria-practices-1.2/ - Lighthouse / axe documentation and common patterns. - Internal design tokens page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/TOK/Color+and+Focus+Tokens Appendix: quick example snippets (copy into a PR): - Token option markup shorthand:

- Toast live region:
If anything here needs to be split into a separate RFC or design ticket, flag in comments and I will extract. This is intentionally informal — capture any quick bits in the doc and we will refine before the sync. Last edit log: - 2026-03-05: Initial quick pass (Leah). - 2026-03-12: Added tokenizer and dropdown detail after pairing (Marcus & Aisha). - 2026-03-18: Added grooming estimates and meeting time (Leah).
